name: permanent fields scan in lexicographic field order
input: one key with three fields and a prefix filter
test:
db = InMemoryDatabase()
db.set('profile', 'city', 'Lima')
db.set('profile', 'age', '29')
db.set('profile', 'email', 'a@example.com')
assert db.get('profile', 'city') == 'Lima'
assert db.scan('profile') == ['age(29)', 'city(Lima)', 'email(a@example.com)']
assert db.scan_by_prefix('profile', 'e') == ['email(a@example.com)']
assert db.delete('profile', 'city') is True
assert db.delete('profile', 'city') is False
assert db.get('profile', 'city') is None

name: timestamped reads honor start times and half-open TTLs
input: one permanent timestamped field and one five-unit TTL field
test:
db = InMemoryDatabase()
db.set_at('job', 'owner', 'Ada', 10)
db.set_at_with_ttl('job', 'state', 'running', 10, 5)
assert db.get_at('job', 'owner', 9) is None
assert db.get_at('job', 'owner', 10) == 'Ada'
assert db.get_at('job', 'state', 14) == 'running'
assert db.get_at('job', 'state', 15) is None
assert db.scan_at('job', 12) == ['owner(Ada)', 'state(running)']
assert db.scan_by_prefix_at('job', 's', 12) == ['state(running)']
assert db.delete_at('job', 'state', 15) is False
assert db.delete_at('job', 'owner', 15) is True
assert db.get_at('job', 'owner', 15) is None

name: backup stores remaining TTL and restore selects the latest qualifying snapshot
input: a backup at 23, a later backup at 30, then a restore targeted at time 29
test:
db = InMemoryDatabase()
db.set_at_with_ttl('task', 'state', 'queued', 20, 8)
db.set_at_with_ttl('task', 'lease', 'worker-1', 20, 20)
db.backup(23)
db.set_at('task', 'state', 'changed', 24)
db.backup(30)
db.restore(40, 29)
assert db.get_at('task', 'state', 44) == 'queued'
assert db.get_at('task', 'state', 45) is None
assert db.get_at('task', 'lease', 56) == 'worker-1'
assert db.get_at('task', 'lease', 57) is None

name: backups are isolated and no qualifying restore is a no-op
input: a snapshot followed by a live mutation and an earlier restore target
test:
db = InMemoryDatabase()
db.set_at_with_ttl('cache', 'answer', '42', 0, 10)
db.backup(3)
db.set_at('cache', 'answer', '99', 4)
db.restore(20, 2)
assert db.get_at('cache', 'answer', 20) == '99'
db.restore(30, 3)
assert db.get_at('cache', 'answer', 36) == '42'
assert db.get_at('cache', 'answer', 37) is None

for call in (
    lambda: db.set_at('x', 'y', 'z', -1),
    lambda: db.set_at_with_ttl('x', 'y', 'z', 1, 0),
    lambda: db.get_at('x', 'y', -1),
):
    try:
        call()
        raise AssertionError('expected ValueError')
    except ValueError:
        pass
